<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def slots(f):
    r=f.ascii.split('\n')
    def s(row,c0):
        seg=r[row][c0:c0+4]
        return seg[0] if len(set(seg))==1 and seg[0] not in 'c' else '.'
    return [s(23,c) for c in (21,27,33,39)],[s(36,c) for c in (21,27,33,39)]
print('before', slots(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':23,'col':40},{'action':'MOUSE','row':23,'col':34}])
print('after clicks', slots(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
